title: Richard R NDE 3955
content: I was lying in a hospital room. At first, the strangest thing happened. There was a picture on the wall. It had a man in a straw hat and pants and suspenders. He was in a large cornfield. All of a sudden, he stood up and wiped the sweat off his forehead. Then a woman, she was the deceased mother of my girlfriend, walked out of the corn with a pitcher of water. She gave him a glass of water. He took a sip and then they smiled at me (my girlfriend has the pitcher at her house; I had never seen it before this). When I described it to her, she told me she had the pitcher upstairs in her house. Then for a short time, I was just shocked. Then I went into respiratory arrest. This happens a lot to me. There was this most amazing bright light. All of a sudden, I was in the most beautiful place. The sky was so blue. The weather was so perfect. I was outside looking at this huge big open lawn. Every member of my family and friends who had died was there, even my dogs. I felt calmer than at any time in my life. I have never felt so at peace or happy. Then my brother came over to me, hugged me, smiled, and said it wasn't my time yet and then all of a sudden I was awake and gasping for breath and surrounded by a whole lot of doctors and nurses. Since then I have felt so much calmer. Death doesn't scare me like it did before. It is hard to explain. I know that I am not going to die when my body dies. I guess you would have to have it happen to you to know what I am talking about. As bad as my health is, I do not get depressed. Doctors and everyone else are amazed by this. Since then I have had more than one person tell me they like to talk to me when they are depressed because I make them feel better. It completely changed my life. Why was this time so much deeper than the others? Did the doctors bring me back faster? I have had other experiences other times but this was the most intense. I have died several times. Other times I have never left the room. Sometimes my only sense is hearing. I could hear everything around me. More than one of the times, I was watching the doctors around my body. When that happens, my senses are so much more acute. I have so many questions I need to ask?

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Respiratory arrest in hospital; reports this happens often.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Before respiratory arrest, saw an animated scene in a wall picture including deceased girlfriend's mother and a specific pitcher later confirmed to exist.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Includes a pre-arrest veridical/visionary scene from a wall picture before the bright light and arrival in a beautiful outdoor place with deceased loved ones.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Reports multiple prior deaths/episodes: sometimes never left the room; sometimes only hearing; sometimes watching doctors around his body with acute senses.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Animated wall picture scene: man in cornfield; deceased girlfriend's mother brings pitcher of water; later girlfriend confirms she owns the pitcher (experiencer says he had never seen it).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “There was this most amazing bright light.”; “All of a sudden, I was in the most beautiful place.”; “Every member of my family and friends who had died was there, even my dogs.”; “It wasn't my time yet.”; “I know that I am not going to die when my body dies.”
